title: MySQL — tables and the 13 foreign keys with delete rules
caption: SHOW TABLES lists the nine tables and information_schema lists the 13 foreign keys with their delete rules.

title: MySQL — DESCRIBE users, DESCRIBE auctions, indexes of bids
caption: DESCRIBE shows the column types of users and auctions and information_schema.STATISTICS lists the bids indexes including the unique (auction_id, amount).

title: MySQL — START TRANSACTION, INSERT, ROLLBACK
caption: An artist inserted inside a transaction is visible to the session, then ROLLBACK removes it and the second SELECT returns no row.

title: MySQL — two sessions, SELECT … FOR UPDATE
caption: Session 2 asked for the same auction row 1 second after session 1 and its SELECT … FOR UPDATE returned only after session 1 rolled back, as the timestamps show.

title: MySQL — optimistic lock with the version column
caption: The first UPDATE ... WHERE version = old matches 1 row and bumps the version, the repeat with the stale version matches 0 rows; the transaction is rolled back.

title: MySQL — foreign key without ON DELETE, ERROR 1451
caption: Deleting an artist that still has an exhibition and artworks is refused with ERROR 1451 (the fk_artworks_artist constraint, delete rule NO ACTION) and the transaction is rolled back.

title: MySQL — ON DELETE SET NULL on artworks.exhibition_id
caption: Deleting exhibition 2 inside a transaction sets exhibition_id to NULL on its artworks; ROLLBACK restores the links.

title: MySQL — ON DELETE CASCADE on user_roles.user_id
caption: Deleting a temporary user removes its user_roles row automatically; ROLLBACK leaves no trace of the temporary user.

title: MySQL — UNIQUE (auction_id, amount) and CHECK constraint
caption: A duplicate bid amount fails with ERROR 1062 and a negative exhibition budget fails with ERROR 3819; both transactions are rolled back.

title: MySQL — SQL issued by Hibernate for one bid
caption: General query log of the connection that placed a bid through the API: autocommit off, SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the auction, INSERT into bids, UPDATE auctions, COMMIT.
